raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

With prefix caching off, `EngineCore` still builds the request block hasher whenever any KV connector is configured, so a NIXL (or DecodeBench) decode instance hashes every admitted prompt in the EngineCore input thread (contending for the GIL with the busy loop) even though nothing reads `Request.block_hashes`. This adds `KVConnectorBase_V1.requires_block_hashes` (default `True`) and opts out NIXL (pull and push) and DecodeBench. It also trims `BlockPool.get_new_blocks` when caching is off.

## Claims

- P/D decode instances with `--no-enable-prefix-caching` + NIXL/DecodeBench no longer hash prompts: admitting a 135K-token prompt takes 3.8 ms of EngineCore CPU instead of 8.9 ms (sha256) / 31 ms (sha256_cbor).
- `get_new_blocks` without caching or metrics: 253 → 168 us per 4000 blocks.
- No behavior change for connectors that read `block_hashes` (offloading, LMCache, Mooncake store, hf3fs, UMBP, Example, ...): they keep the default `True`. `MultiConnector` hashes if any child needs it.

## Validation

**Correctness**

| Test | Result |
| --- | --- |
| NIXL 1P1D GSM8K, Qwen3-0.6B, `--no-enable-prefix-caching`, pull (`NixlConnector`) | 0.423 (threshold 0.36), passed |
| same, push (`NixlPushConnector`) | 0.424, passed |
| new `test_prompt_hashing_without_prefix_caching` (DecodeBench, MultiConnector[DecodeBench], Example) | 3 passed; DecodeBench cases fail on main |
| `tests/v1/core/{test_prefix_caching,test_kv_cache_utils,test_scheduler,test_single_type_kv_cache_manager,test_async_scheduler}.py`, `tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/{test_nixl_connector,test_decode_bench_connector,test_multi_connector,test_handshake_pp_aggregation}.py`, `tests/v1/engine/test_engine_core.py` | all passed except 3 that fail identically on main in my environment (`test_engine_core_tp`: NUMA binding/timeout; `test_multi_example_connector_consistency`: gated HF repo 401; `test_abort_timeout_on_prefiller[ray]`: Ray timeout) |

```bash
KV_CONNECTOR=NixlConnector VLLM_SERVE_EXTRA_ARGS="--no-enable-prefix-caching" bash tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/run_accuracy_test.sh
KV_CONNECTOR=NixlPushConnector VLLM_SERVE_EXTRA_ARGS="--no-enable-prefix-caching" bash tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/run_accuracy_test.sh
pytest tests/v1/engine/test_engine_core.py -k prompt_hashing_without_prefix_caching
```

**EngineCore CPU cost of admitting one prompt** (CPU microbench of `Request.from_engine_core_request` on GB200 Grace, token-id list payload)

| Prompt | no hasher (this PR) | sha256 (main default) | sha256_cbor |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 135K tokens | 3.8 ms | 8.9 ms | 31 ms |
| 855K tokens | 25.9 ms | 60.9 ms | 197 ms |

**Serving A/B** (GB200, one `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --no-enable-prefix-caching` + DecodeBench decode instance; 64 streaming decodes while 30K-token prompts arrive at 20/s; a local-only runtime toggle alternates main/PR behavior in the same server over 8 × 15 s windows; 2 runs)

| Run | Arm | long-prompt TTFT p50 / p99 (ms) | decode ITL p99 (ms) | decode tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | main | 159 / 521 | 95.7 | 3887 |
| 1 | PR | 141 / 396 | 79.9 | 3812 |
| 2 | main | 175 / 608 | 99.3 | 3332 |
| 2 | PR | 145 / 501 | 85.2 | 3594 |

TTFT and ITL p99 improve in both runs; decode throughput is within noise.

## Details

- The property lives on the connector instance (like `requires_kv_delivery`) because `MultiConnector` needs its children to aggregate.
- Only the "prefix caching off" case changes; with caching on the hasher is always built.
- `get_new_blocks`: blocks popped from the free queue always have `ref_cnt == 0`, so assign `1` directly and only loop again when a metrics collector is set.
- Related, complementary work: #63454 (`sha256_int32`) and #63842 (frontend hashing) make hashing cheaper or move it off the engine thread; this PR avoids it entirely where it is unused. #64096 adds a different capability (`supports_lookahead_block_hashes`) and does not change when the hasher is built.
